title: The realtor
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The man whose real-estate flyer shares the rack asks the owner who draws these. She says a boy. He says which boy. She says the one with the dog. He says he's seen the dog. Everyone's seen the dog.

panels.composition: The laundromat. A REALTOR in a windbreaker restocking his flyer in the rack beside the digest. The LAUNDRY owner at the counter.

image.prompt: a man in a windbreaker restocking real-estate flyers in a wire rack beside small booklets in a laundromat while the owner watches, black and white, no words
a man in a windbreaker reading a small photocopied booklet with a puzzled face, black and white, no words
a man in a windbreaker, realizing, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The window. Outside, small, WOOD and BARNABY passing on the sidewalk, not looking in. The realtor looking. Everyone's seen the dog.

image.prompt: through a laundromat window: a young man and a small dog passing on the sidewalk while a man inside watches them, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'The one with the dog.' The dog is how the town knows him.
